leadIn: After completing this lesson, you will be able to:
objectives: Implement a virtualized list component using Vue's composition API
Configure dynamic rendering based on scroll position and viewport height
Manipulate DOM elements to display only visible items within the viewport
Initialize and update state variables to track scroll position and visible range
Bind scroll event handlers to trigger re-rendering of visible items
Construct a reusable virtual list that maintains performance with large datasets
Integrate item height calculations to determine total scrollable container size
